 About the match
 On this page you can find the Al Zawraa vs Al-Nasr SC match lineup for Gulf Club Champions League — Round 2 - First Leg, on Wednesday 28-10-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Al Zawraa lines up in a 4-2-3-1 led by Adnan, while Al-Nasr SC sets up in a 4-4-2 led by Sequeira. Al Zawraa is led by head coach Basim Qasim, while Al-Nasr SC is managed by Milos Milojevic. The match is played at Al Zawra Stadium.
